entries.en: See, girl... This fucking pool. We're queens, babe, ain't nobody... nobody gonna take that away from us.

entries.en: Hah, used to think it was, like, synth caffeine. Like, like, Caff ER or whatever.

entries.en: Ey, you gonk... Palm trees were in the ad. Not in the glass.

entries.en: Whateverrrs. We'll go to the GIM and spend like... a bajillion eds.
